commands.name: independent frozen fetch counterexamples
commands.result: 6 counterexample assertions failed; each exposes an unmet invariant
commands.harness_note: Initial probe collection also ran an imported TestCase class; the reviewer-only harness was corrected to reference collector_calls through its fixture, then rerun. The six counterexamples remained. No candidate source or test was changed.

commands.name: adjacent research regression boundaries
commands.result: 29 passed; one existing Starlette deprecation warning

findings.finding: A non-article empty BODY can be promoted when the collector summary self-reports article_body_found=true.
findings.evidence: An isolated collector wrote an 83-byte HTML page with an empty body, a header-only image manifest, and a valid-looking identity summary with article_body_found=true and text_preview_length=18. main() returned 0 and reported SOURCE_CAPTURED_BODY_READY / BODY_IDENTITY_VERIFIED.

findings.finding: Verified HTTP-source reuse does not compare actual raw HTML bytes to identity_validation.raw_html_sha256.
findings.evidence: After a successful candidate capture, raw HTML bytes were replaced while the original summary and recorded raw_html_sha256 remained. A second main() call returned SOURCE_REUSED_NEED_OCR rather than rejecting the stale identity.

findings.finding: A prepared image manifest whose first source URL changed is still accepted as the same reusable article source.
findings.evidence: The test created 50 decodable PNGs, ran the real prepare_ocr.main(), then changed only the first manifest URL while retaining image indexes and bytes/SHA. A subsequent fetch returned SOURCE_REUSED_NEED_OCR.

findings.finding: OCR summary status OCR_OK alone makes the state machine report the package as the next stage without OCR result or checkpoint artifacts.
findings.evidence: With 50 source images, the test wrote only {status: OCR_OK, image_count: 50}; windows_ocr_results.json and windows_ocr_checkpoint.json were absent. The next call reported next_missing_stage=package.

findings.finding: The argparse abbreviation --o bypasses exact --out rewriting and lets the collector write outside the isolated attempt directory.
findings.evidence: Calling the adapter with --out <run> --o <escaped-output> caused the isolated fake collector to write wechat_article_raw.html under escaped-output. The adapter later rejected the missing staged summary, but the outside write had already occurred.

findings.finding: A saved-HTML promotion interrupted after the active summary commit but before PROMOTION_RECEIPT cannot recover on the next invocation.
findings.evidence: KeyboardInterrupt was injected immediately before PROMOTION_RECEIPT creation. On the next call, _existing_verified_source raised 'saved HTML source lacks an immutable promotion receipt'; main returned 2 before _recover_pending_attempt could finish promotion.

findings.finding: When the current HK receipt is read but its panel SHA binding fails, the probe drops the readable receipt facts and SHA from the final probe.
findings.evidence: The test changed a synthetic current HK Parquet after writing a valid READY receipt. The receipt had READY and row_count=1; the returned probe instead had current_receipt_status=CANNOT_CONFIRM and no current_receipt_sha256. All HK prices remained null, so the failure is disclosure completeness rather than price leakage.

positive_results: The 108-listing PARTIAL-plus-row_count-mismatch synthetic appendix test preserves all 81 A, 3 BJ, and 24 HK rows; prices remain null and statuses CANNOT_CONFIRM.

The appendix JSON retains PARTIAL, target_date_file_count=5137, target_count=5800, coverage_rate, row_count=5261, sync authority REBUILD_REQUIRED, and receipt SHA; the Markdown labels 5137/5800 as panel coverage rather than a 108-code match rate.
The HK missing-prior-session receipt path and date are disclosed; the 24 HK values stay null, and Markdown states that zero valid observations do not mean a 0% return.
Failed A/BJ and HK probe functions are cached once per appendix generation in the synthetic 108-listing case.
The adjacent 29-test regression set preserves per-code invalid HK denominator behavior; invalid values do not discard the valid listing.
limitations: The frozen Mac runner, external collector, parent-level AGENTS.md, and active runtime are absent from the supplied source snapshot.
No real Mac, Vision OCR, WeChat request, market panel, scheduler, Drive connection, or full recovery-to-Drive flow was run.
Synthetic offline fixtures do not establish real Mac behavior; those states remain CANNOT_CONFIRM.
Pytest basetemp directories were temporary and are not deliverables.
